referents.why: 'Their secret arts' belong to the magicians, named as subject of cl0 (masculine plural).
'They brought up the frogs' is third masculine plural, the magicians.

links.why: A then-link runs within a verse only. The comparison with Aaron's deed in Exo.8.2 is the likewise link.
'The magicians did so (ken)' with a named subject, doing what Aaron just did, and they were not commanded. Imitation, not fulfilment; Aaron's act follows the latest command.
Bringing up frogs is what their arts bring about, so the relation is an outcome.
The magicians did likewise by their arts, and they brought up the frogs: the frogs are what the arts bring about.
